description.en: A short note from Bavko to Tobolko.
description.sl: Kratko sporočilo od Bavka za Tobolka.

description.en: A new bell for the shrine. It rings like a popping bubble.
description.sl: Nov zvonec za svetišče. Zazvoni kot mehurček, ki poči.

description.en: Its little cups spin in the wind. Vetrinka asked for it.
description.sl: Njegove skodelice se vrtijo v vetru. Vetrinka ga je naročila.

description.en: Soaked and cold, with no sender. It came on the wind.
description.sl: Premočeno in hladno, brez pošiljatelja. Prinesel ga je veter.

description.en: A soft berry that grows where clouds touch the grass.
description.sl: Mehka jagoda, ki raste, kjer se oblaki dotikajo trave.

description.en: A cool leaf that smells like a windy morning.
description.sl: Hladen list, ki diši po vetrovnem jutru.

description.en: A warm, golden root. It glows a little in the dark.
description.sl: Topel, zlat koren. V temi rahlo sveti.

description.en: A tiny mushroom with frost on its cap, even in summer.
description.sl: Drobna gobica z ivjem na klobučku, tudi poleti.

description.en: A small round fish that skips between clouds like a pebble on water.
description.sl: Majhna okrogla riba, ki skaklja med oblaki kot kamenček po vodi.

description.en: A quick fish with fins like little sails.
description.sl: Hitra riba s plavutmi kot majhna jadra.

description.en: A shiny fish that swims deep below the island.
description.sl: Bleščeča riba, ki plava globoko pod otokom.

description.en: Warm and sweet. Sun and Bloom creatures like it.
description.sl: Topla in sladka. Všeč je sončnim in cvetnim bitjem.

description.en: Crunchy and salty. Rain and Storm creatures like it.
description.sl: Hrustljav in slan. Všeč je deževnim in nevihtnim bitjem.

description.en: Soft and fresh. Gale and Bloom creatures like it.
description.sl: Mehak in svež. Všeč je vetrnim in cvetnim bitjem.

description.en: Light as a cloud. Frost and Rain creatures like it.
description.sl: Lahka kot oblak. Všeč je mrzlim in deževnim bitjem.

description.en: Hot from the pot. Storm and Sun creatures like it.
description.sl: Vroč iz lonca. Všeč je nevihtnim in sončnim bitjem.

description.en: Cold, sweet and wobbly. Frost and Gale creatures like it.
description.sl: Hladen, sladek in tresoč. Všeč je mrzlim in vetrnim bitjem.
